claim_label: Whether Congress should mandate cryptographic AI audit trails
description: This conflict concerns whether Congress should require cryptographic, subject-keyed audit trails for high-risk AI models. Proponents argue these mandates are essential for accountability and security, while opponents contend they create a pervasive corporate panopticon and violate user privacy.

instances.assertion: Congress must mandate standardized cryptographic audit trails to secure supply chains and shift the burden of proof to deployers before systemic, irreversible failures occur.

Congress must reject cryptographic tracking mandates because requiring a cryptographic signature for every input and output constructs a permanent corporate panopticon and destroys the user's right to be forgotten.
